newsitem.title: CHINA: China summer grain harvest seen 123.95 mln tonnes.
newsitem.headline: China summer grain harvest seen 123.95 mln tonnes.

text.p: China's summer grain harvest was seen at 123.95 million tonnes, according to an initial estimate issued by the State Statistical Bureau on Tuesday.
That marked an increase of 10.75 million tonnes from last year, it said.
Earlier official forecasts had said the summer grain harvest would be 115 million tonnes.
The Ministry of Internal Trade has forecast grain output for this year at above 484 million tonnes, compared with a record 490 million tonnes last year.
Officials have said an ongoing drought in the north and floods in the south could damage the main autumn harvest this year.
Officials have said last year's total grain crop probably was slightly larger than the reported 490 million tonne level.
